summary: Verified all DQN (Deep Q-Network) features for Iteration 20: 1) DQN module exists and is properly imported (/app/backend/ml/dqn.py), 2) RL Engine uses DQN by default (use_dqn=True), 3) /api/rl/stats returns DQN-specific fields (architecture, device, buffer_beta, avg_loss_100), 4) /api/rl/switch-mode endpoint works to switch between DQN and Q-table modes, 5) Prioritized Experience Replay is enabled (prioritized_replay: true), 6) Target network update frequency is 100, 7) Neural network architecture is 8 -> 64 -> 64 -> 7, 8) RL Learning tab in UI shows DQN badge, Prioritized Replay badge, and architecture details. Neural network architecture correctly implements 8 -> 64 -> 64 -> 7 (Input -> Hidden1 -> Hidden2 -> Output)

Double DQN implemented to reduce overestimation (uses policy net for action selection, target net for evaluation)
Target network updates every 100 training iterations for stable learning
RL Engine defaults to DQN mode (use_dqn=True in __init__)
Frontend properly displays DQN badge, Prioritized Replay badge, and architecture details in RL Learning tab
